description: When a manager submits the Freed slot offer approval form, emails the drafted offer to the chosen candidates (the numbers entered, "all", or the recommended ones when left blank). It first checks the slot is still in the future and nobody has been booked into it, and never emails the same slot's patients twice. The WorkQ item stays open, waiting for the first patient to reply YES. Choosing "Don't offer this slot" closes the item without sending anything.

flowIr.description: Triggered by the Freed slot offer approval form: sends the approved offers by email and hands off to the reply checker.
flowIr.name: Cliniko Automations: Send approved slot offers
